from sklearn.datasets import load_diabetes
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures

X, y = load_diabetes(return_X_y=True, as_frame=True)
X = X[["bmi", "bp", "s5", "s3"]]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
X_fit, X_val, y_fit, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=0)

def poly_model(degree):
    return make_pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(degree=degree, include_bias=False), LinearRegression())

val_scores = {d: poly_model(d).fit(X_fit, y_fit).score(X_val, y_val) for d in range(1, 7)}
best_degree = max(val_scores, key=val_scores.get)
test_r2 = poly_model(best_degree).fit(X_train, y_train).score(X_test, y_test)
print(val_scores, best_degree, test_r2)

checks.test: test_r2 is not None and abs(float(test_r2) - __import__('sklearn.pipeline', fromlist=['make_pipeline']).make_pipeline(__import__('sklearn.preprocessing', fromlist=['PolynomialFeatures']).PolynomialFeatures(degree=best_degree, include_bias=False), __import__('sklearn.linear_model', fromlist=['LinearRegression']).LinearRegression()).fit(X_train, y_train).score(X_test, y_test)) < 1e-6
